content: {"praised":["Top notch sci-fi entertainment with detailed, engaging storytelling.","Philosophically interesting, reminiscent of Primer and Blade Runner.","Keeps audience guessing, every frame counts.","Strong visual and thematic depth.","Excellent pacing for a complex plot."],"criticized":["Ending feels flat and unsatisfying.","Excessive scientific jargon, unintelligible and annoying.","Odd romance choices and unnecessary drama.","Weak writing leaves questions unanswered.","Pacing drags in the second half."]}
